title: Weekly team recaps
goal: The league office wants one recap per team every Monday for the newsletter and the website, produced in the league's AWS account, with fan-facing data processed in the US only, for under $5 a week.
functional: One 90-130 word recap per team per week, from that team's box score
Headline plus one paragraph, in the newsletter's style
Only facts from the box score: no scores, opponents, injuries or quotes
success_criteria: At least 90% of the 20 hand-checked recaps from last season pass the recap eval
No recap that passes today fails after a change (no regressions)
